entities.summary: Antoon van den Heuvel, Antoine van den Heuvel or Anton van den Heuvel was a Flemish history painter and draughtsman. After training and working in Antwerp and Rome, he returned to his native Ghent where he was one of the important creators of altarpieces for the churches in the region.
